_comment: DeepTutor model profiles routed through the LiteLLM gateway (P2). Seeded into each DeepTutor pod's data/user/settings/ by an initContainer. base_url points at the in-cluster gateway Service; api_key is the gateway master key (injected by the initContainer from the LITELLM_MASTER_KEY secret). binding stays openai (gateway is OpenAI-compatible).
